mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level, as measured by the number of persons employed, indicates strengthening economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts index (HOUST) falls below 1800 units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector, which typically precedes a slowdown in consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1800, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both the housing starts (HOUST) and the consumer spending indicator (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in the demand for goods and services, which typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), the manufacturing sector slowdown typically leads to reduced corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending indicator (RSAFS) signals increased household purchasing power, which typically translates to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market that typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 190.0 signals an inflationary monetary policy response that typically causes equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 190.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
